summary: TNL Mediagene filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing its FY2025 annual results and its prior Annual Report on Form 20-F. The filing discusses financial highlights, including a net loss reduction to $44.6 million, cost-cutting initiatives, and leadership changes previously disclosed on April 2, 2026. There are no transaction terms, prices, or special-situation events—only routine periodic earnings disclosure and business updates. This is a standard foreign private issuer report, not a special-situation filing.
